input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: quick-pick-survey flagship item (a), does the 'between X, Y, Z' list hold the true favourite; replace it with a refit credible set
errors: npm ci --ignore-scripts skipped prisma generate, so the first npm run verify failed typecheck on @prisma/client; fixed with npx prisma generate (setup error, not a code error)

doc_friction.issue: says run npm run verify but not that a fresh clone needs `npx prisma generate` (or npm ci with scripts) first; a cloud session that installs with --ignore-scripts gets dozens of misleading TS errors
'The clear-top-pick claim' called the 'it's between X, Y, Z' line true without measuring it; it held the favourite 68-74% of the time. Corrected in this PR.

notes: Idea (explore): measure whether the insights card's contender list holds the true favourite, and replace 'the three highest' with a 95% credible set from the Bradley-Terry Laplace refit (src/lib/favouriteSet.ts). Measured on 540 synthetic respondents per row x 2 seed sets: three highest 0.68-0.74 coverage, set 0.88-0.92 at mean size 5-6. Found undercoverage caused by the prior being wider than simulated truth (winner's curse); a narrower prior reaches nominal but was not shipped (would tune to the simulator). Verification: npm run verify (typecheck, lint, unit tests, build) and the insights integration tests against scripts/test-db.sh Postgres; the new integration case fails with the old route.ts and passes with the new one.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician designing, measuring and shipping a calibrated contender set with tests and a write-up: about 1.5 days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
